purpose: Rebuke behavior as exceeding an acceptable limit.
keywords: N / な-adjective stem + にもほどがある; plain clause + にもほどがある
There is a limit to joking.
That remark is irresponsibility taken too far.
There is a limit to how long you can keep someone waiting.
formation: N / な-adjective stem + にもほどがある; plain clause + にもほどがある
restrictions: Common in direct complaints about excess.
mistake: It sounds judgmental, so it is not a neutral degree description.
